decisions.reason: The abstract directly states that NCLs/Batten disease (neuronal ceroid lipofuscinosis) result in lysosomal dysfunction 'which...has a devastating impact on the central nervous system.' The quoted sentence contains the CNS impact, and the surrounding abstract clearly establishes that this describes the effects of neuronal ceroid lipofuscinosis. The CNS involvement is a documented clinical phenotype of NCLs. The relationship is directly supported by the text.
